label: Storytellers
title: Book a storyteller
summary: Rather not record an elder yourself? Book a trained storyteller from the platform to sit with them, record their stories and help turn them into a book.

choices: Yes, for a birthday or anniversary
No, it is for our own family
form.messageLabel: Tell us about the person whose stories you would like to keep
form.messageHint: Who they are to you, where they live, the languages they speak and any date you have in mind. We will match you with a storyteller who speaks their language.

label: The Roots Kit
title: Ask, record, keep
summary: Guided question cards, recording tips and a family-book template, so you can capture your elders' stories yourself, wherever you live.

form.messageLabel: Who would you use it with?
form.messageHint: For example: my grandmother in Darbhanga, over video calls from London.

label: The family book
title: Their words, on paper
summary: Your archive laid out as a book. Print it at home, or have it bound for every home in the family.

form.messageHint: Roughly how many entries and photographs, who it is for and the date you need it by.

label: Journeys
title: Roots journeys with local hosts
summary: Go back to where your family began with a host who knows the place, or spend a few days with a tradition and the people who keep it.

choices: A journey to my own family's place
form.messageHint: If it is your family's place, tell us where it is and what you know about it. We will introduce you to a host there as hosts join.

label: Commission a piece
title: Commission original work
summary: A painting of your family's home town, your family name in a folk art style, a gift for a wedding. Made by a named artist, who sets the price.

choices: A painting of a family place
Our family name in a folk art style
form.messageLabel: Tell us about the piece and the story behind it
form.messageHint: The occasion, the size or the space it is for, a rough budget and when you need it.

label: Gifting
title: Gifts with a story
summary: Gift boxes for family occasions from named makers, each with a card that tells their story. Made to pre-order, never mass-stocked.

form.messageLabel: Tell us what you are looking for
form.messageHint: How many gifts, a budget per gift, and the date they need to arrive.

label: For organisations
title: Roots programmes for groups
summary: Family-history projects for schools, recording afternoons for diaspora and community groups, and heritage partnerships, led by makers and storytellers on the platform.

choices: A family-history project for a school
A programme for a diaspora or community group
form.messageLabel: Tell us about your group and what you have in mind
form.messageHint: Roughly how many people, online or in person, the city, and any dates.
Your craft, where you work, how long you have practised, and a link to photographs of your work if you have one.

choices: Walks and visits in my town or village
Helping families find an old house, temple or street
A day with a tradition I practise
form.messageLabel: Tell us about your place and yourself
form.messageHint: Where you live, the languages you speak, and what a family visiting with you would experience.
The languages you can record in, where you are based, and any recordings or writing we could listen to or read.
What it is, what it means in your family, and how you would like to be credited (first name and place, initials, or anonymous). We read everything before it appears.

choices: The weekly question sent for me
form.messageLabel: Anything you would like the Family plan to do?
